''See also: [[Urg’naut Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Urg’naut is a [[Great Elder]] known as the embodiment of death, absence, and annihilation. Described as an alien and immensely powerful entity, its primary motivation is the pursuit of absolute nothingness and a peace defined by nonexistence. Known also as the [[Creeping Shadow]], Urg’naut does not typically engage in direct combat; instead, its presence or the actions of its spawn cause victims to simply cease to exist. Its influence can manifest as a void that devours minds or shadows that resemble a mass of twisting serpents. Urg’naut has the ability to take human hosts, appearing as a man in silver armor with a face like an endless, radiating black sun. In this form, the entity possesses catastrophic power, capable of erasing vast areas of land and ocean instantaneously. While Urg’naut acts against humanity, it also seeks the annihilation of its own kind and has been known to move through the void between worlds. The entity has expressed an interest in confronting a being referred to as the [[Outsider]], potentially seeking salvation through such a conflict.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Known as the [[Creeping Shadow]], this entity appears as a silhouette of solid [[Shadow|shadow]] and an embodiment of infinite shadows. Its face is described as an endless hole resembling a black sun, while its [[Shadow|shadow]] takes the form of a seething nest of twisting serpents. The being can also withdraw its [[Shadow|shadow]] into a twisting column or take on a human form.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As the [[Great Elder]] of Annihilation, Urg’naut possesses a distant and alien malice that causes dread. The entity is driven by an insatiable [[hunger]] and seeks to destroy the world to achieve a peace defined as nonexistence. It aims to save people from pain by bringing absolute nothingness and unending rest to all things.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Urg'naut is the progenitor of [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten]], a spawn who can be located by the [[Great Elder]] within the void. This entity also faces off against [[Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin]] and engages in combat with the [[Outsider]]. Additionally, Urg'naut spoke to [[Darius Allbright]], offering him unending rest, and was the creature [[Shera]] commanded [[Meia]] to be devoured by. Finally, [[Kelarac]] shared information regarding Urg'naut with [[Jerri]], and [[Zhen of the Masons{{!}}Zhen]] is known to invoke the being, while [[Loreli]] once pierced the location associated with him.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Urg’naut can cause people to cease to exist rather than simply killing them, and it has the power to devour thoughts. The entity can tilt minds through subtlety and attempts to take hosts by slithering into people. Additionally, it is a mighty being capable of erasing large portions of a city and can find its spawn within the void.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Urg’naut]] ascended into the void to meet the [[Outsider]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Urg’naut]] is fighting an opponent of impossible power.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Urg’naut]] escaped.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Calder]] did not overhear [[Urg’naut|Urg'naut]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Urg’naut]] is fighting the [[Outsider]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] stated that [[Urg’naut]] won.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Urg’naut]] has departed.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Don’t worry. We know you can’t force Urg’naut back into his seal, or keep Ach’magut from rebuilding his library, or do anything useful.”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“A spawn of Urg’naut,” Calder Marten explained.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“It’s here,” Calder whispered. “Urg’naut. He’s found me.”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“Urg’naut took human form and escaped,” Calder told her.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“Urg’naut won,” Shera said, looking into the sky.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}
